id.title: Tidak ada yang datang… Hari Orang Tua bagi seorang kakek berusia 98 tahun
id.description:
#NoGangja #HariOrangTua #BungaAnyelir

Kami mengikuti perjalanan Kakek No Gangja saat ia merayakan Hari Orang Tuanya yang ke-98.

Kisah seorang pemuda berusia 98 tahun yang menjalani setiap harinya dengan lebih teguh daripada siapa pun, meskipun sendirian.

Itu adalah hari istimewa yang dipenuhi tawa, kesepian, dan beban hidup.

Mari kita dukung Kakek No Gangja, yang menjalani hidupnya dengan caranya sendiri hari ini juga.

en-US.title: No one came… A 98-year-old grandfather’s Parents’ Day
en-US.description:
#NoGangja #ParentsDay #Carnation

We followed the day of Grandpa No Gangja as he celebrated his 98th Parents' Day.

The story of a 98-year-old youth who lives each day more steadfastly than anyone else, despite being alone.

It was a special day filled with laughter, loneliness, and the weight of life.

Please cheer for Grandpa No Gangja, who lives his life his own way today as well.

snippet.title: 술 담배 했는데도 98세… 진짜 비결은 따로 있다[98세 노강자]
snippet.description:
술과 담배를 해왔음에도 불구하고 98세까지 장수한 한 어르신.
상식과는 다른 그의 삶을 따라가며, 우리가 놓치고 있던 진짜 장수의 조건을 들여다봅니다.

습관 하나하나보다 더 중요했던 것은
삶을 대하는 태도, 관계, 그리고 마음의 방향이었습니다.

과연 오래 사는 사람들은 무엇이 달랐을까요?
숫자와 규칙이 아닌, 사람의 이야기로 풀어보는 장수의 비결을 만나보세요.

What sets longevity apart?
Discover the secrets of longevity, unraveled through human stories, not numbers and rules.
